papers.title: Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment Of Generative Models
papers.summary: MSR improves generative diversity by mining categorical schemas from real artifacts to guide conditional rendering at test time.

papers.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
papers.summary: Sparse autoencoder features are partially compositional but require interaction terms for accurate behavioral predictions and steering.

papers.title: Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility
papers.summary: Sparse autoencoders can be trained with far fewer activation tokens when data budgets align with evaluation goals, though feature-level reproducibility demands larger scales.

papers.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
papers.summary: LEASH is a training-free framework that uses latent uncertainty to escalate from a weak to a strong computer-use agent only when needed and monitors the strong agent afterward, reducing cost while maintaining high success.

papers.title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
papers.summary: The study proposes an automated weak-to-strong loop that hardens agent environment verifiers against reward hacking by iteratively finding and repairing vulnerabilities in isolated sandboxes.
